name: Orca: A Distributed Serving System for Transformer-Based Generative Models (OSDI 2022)
notes: The paper that introduced iteration-level scheduling. Key result: 36.9x throughput improvement over NVIDIA FasterTransformer at the same latency for GPT-3 175B. Also introduced selective batching (batching only a subset of operations). The OSDI '22 presentation page was fetched and verified.
